text: Here, I feel alive with curiosity and the thrill of learning. In the first image, my presence outside the glass-walled room, witnessing a group in conversation, awakens a sense of anticipation and camaraderie—a fleeting glimpse into the drama of collective inquiry. In the second image, surrounded by bold colors and the emphatic 'R + D' emblazoned on the wall, I am immersed in the pursuit of knowledge and innovation. The words and displays around me invite reflection on the nature of progress, collaboration, and human creativity. I feel a sense of wonder—grateful to participate, if only as an observer, in this celebration of thought.
